exposure: Introduction of a structured diabetes in pregnancy proforma
outcome: Rate of missing pre-pregnancy/first trimester HbA1c
Rate of missing third trimester HbA1c
Rate of missing folate intake and dose documentation
Rate of missing retinopathy and nephropathy progression documentation
cohort: Pregnant women with pre-gestational type 1 or type 2 diabetes mellitus
finding: The introduction of a structured diabetes in pregnancy proforma was associated with improved quality of medical record documentation and a reduction in macrosomia rates.
mod_finding: The study found that macrosomia (large birth weight) significantly reduced after the introduction of a structured diabetes in pregnancy proforma.
